full_prompt_en: A square pastel fashion image divides into three vertical color panels, each showing the same young woman in a slightly different stance. The left background is pale lime, the center a cool powder blue, and the right a soft blush pink, with clean straight boundaries between the fields. The woman has light pink-blond hair falling to her shoulders, straight bangs, and a neutral expression as she looks toward the camera. In each panel she wears a loose cropped jacket, a short high-waisted skirt, pale socks, and bulky white sneakers. The garments shift in mint, lemon, baby blue, and peach from one version to the next, yet their soft colors remain within the same airy range. A small structured shoulder bag hangs at her side in every view, alternating between cream, pink, and mint accents. The repeated full-length figure stands on a narrow light floor strip, one knee subtly bent and one foot placed ahead of the other. Distinct gray-blue shadows stretch to the lower left of the shoes, giving the otherwise flat background a clear contact point. The left figure appears slightly closer to the edge, the middle figure more upright, and the right figure has a gentle angle through the shoulders. Even bright studio light falls from the upper right, making hair and pale fabric softly luminous without strong glossy highlights; the floor shadows are more defined than the modeling across the body. Details remain lightly softened, as if seen through a pastel veil, while the silhouettes and accessories are readable. The overall composition turns a simple repeated pose into a crisp rhythm of candy-colored vertical blocks and soft fashion texture.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形粉彩时装图分为三个竖向色块，每格都是同一位年轻女子的略有变化的站姿。左侧背景是浅酸橙绿，中央为冷粉蓝，右侧是柔和胭脂粉，色域之间以干净直线分隔。女子的浅粉金发垂至肩部，有平直刘海，望向相机时神情平静。每格中她都穿宽松短夹克、高腰短裙、浅色袜子和厚底白球鞋。衣服从一格到下一格在薄荷、柠檬黄、婴儿蓝和桃色间变化，但柔和色调始终保持在同一轻盈范围。一只小而有结构的肩包挂在身旁，每幅分别带奶油、粉和薄荷色强调。重复的全身人物立在窄浅色地面带上，一边膝盖略弯，一只脚置于另一只前方。明显的灰蓝影子从鞋下向左下伸展，为几乎平面的背景提供清楚接触点。左格人物略靠近边缘，中格更直立，右格肩部有轻轻的倾角。明亮均匀的影棚光从右上照下，让头发和浅色织物柔和发亮，没有强烈光滑高光；地上投影比身体上的塑形更明确。细节像隔了一层粉彩薄纱而略微柔化，剪影和配件仍能读清。整体构图把简单重复站姿转为糖果色竖向色块和柔软时装肌理的清脆节奏。
style_prompt_en: The image has a clean editorial finish organized by adjacent pastel color fields and repeated vertical beats. Mint, powder blue, blush, pale lemon, and cream remain light and low in contrast, with fine warm-cool shifts distinguishing neighboring regions. Edges are mostly crisp at the layout level but gently softened inside the focal forms, creating an airy veil without losing silhouette clarity. Bright studio light spreads evenly from above, while compact floor shadows provide the main evidence of depth. Surfaces look smooth and lightly powdered rather than heavily textured or glossy. The overall treatment is playful, orderly, and weightless, with repetition making subtle color changes easy to see.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有干净的编辑式完成面，由相邻粉彩色域与重复竖向节拍组织。薄荷、粉蓝、胭脂粉、浅柠檬黄与奶油色都轻浅且低反差，细微冷暖变化区分相邻区域。布局边界大体清楚，焦点形体内部则轻轻柔化，形成通透薄纱感而不损失剪影清晰度。明亮影棚光从上方均匀散开，紧凑的地面阴影提供主要纵深证据。表面光滑且略带粉感，并不厚重粗糙或光亮。整体处理俏皮、有序而轻盈，重复让细小色差易于察觉。
theme_en: A three-panel pastel fashion study of a young woman
theme_zh: 同一位年轻女子的三格粉彩时装造型展示
name: Pastel colors
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
